name: enterprise-360-app
description: Enterprise 360 Feedback & Performance Management System (clean monorepo)

scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace apps/api run typecheck && npm --workspace apps/web run typecheck
scripts.db:apply: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml cp database/000_initial_schema.sql postgres:/schema.sql && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml exec -T postgres psql -U postgres -d enterprise360 -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f /schema.sql && npm run db:reconcile
scripts.db:reconcile: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml cp database/001_reconcile.sql postgres:/reconcile.sql && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml exec -T postgres psql -U postgres -d enterprise360 -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f /reconcile.sql
scripts.sis:setup: npm run sis:generate && npm run sis:push && npm run sis:seed
